messages:
Anya: Quick heads-up — I reproduced a perf regression on an SM86 GPU when seq_len > 2048. Kernel selector is switching to fused_attention_v2 which seems ~2x slower for long sequences. Dumping probe + perf snippets below.

Anya: probe.json snippet:
```
gpu: SM 86
tensor_cores: yes
bf16_supported: partial
fp8_experimental: true
preferred_kernels: [tile_attn_v1, fused_attention_v2]
selector_decision: fused_attention_v2 (seq_len=3072, batch=4)
```

Jordan: Can you paste the raw perf numbers? is KV cache throughput affected or just attention kernel?

Anya: quick perf: (seq_len=3072, batch=4)
```
tile_attn_v1: avg_kernel_ms=1.2, p95=1.7
fused_attention_v2: avg_kernel_ms=2.8, p95=4.1
KV cache read latency: +0.6ms (more memcpy churn when fused_attn allocates extra temp buffers)
total tail latency delta: +18%
```

Matt: weird — fused_attn_v2 usually wins on Ampere for medium seqs. looks like memory layout/prefetch pattern is off for >2k tokens. maybe the kernel picks a different tiling that thrashes the KV allocator.

Sasha: fwiw if fp8 fastpath is enabled, fused_attn_v2 takes FP8 route. we saw numeric drift earlier (qkv scale mismatch) so we force fallback to FP16 in prod. could that change perf profile?

Anya: good call. this run had fp8_experimental=true but fallback was triggered for stability; still fused_attn chosen even with fp16 fallback. suspect selector decision is primarily sequence-length gated, not memory-pressure aware.

perf-bot: :rotating_light: Perf alert: hosted-us-east-1 saw ~15% increase in tail latency for text-generation between builds 2026-03-10 -> 2026-03-12. Tracepoints point to attention kernels on SM86 machines.

Jordan: Proposed quick fix: change kernel selector to prefer tile_attn_v1 for SM >= 86 when seq_len >= 2048 OR when KV cache miss rate > 5%. Add a cheap runtime probe to record KV miss rate on first request.

Matt: That seems low-risk. Add a flag KERNEL_STRATEGY=seq_gated_override and rollout as a canary to dedicated pool. Also add a synthetic micro-benchmark in perf CI for (seq_len=2048..4096).

Sasha: Note: ensure FP8 fastpath detection remains orthogonal — if fp8 path available we should still prefer stable FP16 variant for long sequences until numeric tests pass. Add a golden-check on cross-entropy for a small eval set.

ci-bot: added job arch-probe-sm86-longseq to the CI matrix (runs tile_attn_v1 vs fused_attention_v2 on seq 512/1024/2048/3072).

perf-bot: logged regression ticket PERF-2391 and attached sample traces.

Jordan: I'll draft the selector patch tonight and open a PR with a toggle. can we A/B test on dedicated-east-1?

Anya: yes — canary on dedicated-east-1, add KV cache warmup to the canary startup (prepopulate prefixes to reduce initial misses). I'll attach logs once it's running. :thumbsup:

Matt: also add an infra check: if allocator fragmentation > threshold, don’t pick fused path. I've seen fused kernels allocate large scratch memory which amplifies fragmentation.

Sasha: +1. we should add a telemetry counter for "kernel_scratch_bytes" per request. helps correlate with tail spikes.

Anya: sounds good. moving to implement: update selector rules, add canary, CI job, telemetry. will post PR and a short runbook for rollbacks.

Jordan: thanks — this feels safe and measurable. we'll revert if perf doesn't improve.

Anya: ping @everyone when canary is up.
